# Coverage Checklist: Módulo Microsoft 365

**Purpose**: Validar a cobertura, clareza e consistência dos requisitos da overview executiva e do seam de integração com Microsoft Graph
**Created**: 2026-06-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required contents of each of the four `summaryCards` explicitly specified beyond category names, including what each card must represent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Inertia Page Contract]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required contents of `tenantHighlights`, `recentActivity`, and `nextStep` sufficiently specified to distinguish editorial curation from arbitrary copywriting? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are the requirements explicit about whether all eight `serviceStatus` items must always be present or whether the count may vary by tenant/workload availability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Microsoft365Overview]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec define whether recommendations shown in the overview are a fixed top-N subset or an open-ended executive list? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Recommendation]
- [x] CHK005 Are the submenu expectations documented clearly enough to distinguish “future area communicated in navigation” from “feature area requiring current-page behavior”? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-009a]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “visão geral com indicadores de escala, saúde operacional, segurança, adoção e próxima ação” broken down into objective content expectations for each dimension? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 Is the distinction between `fresh: true` (live Graph call) and `fresh: false` (cache/snapshot served) clearly defined as a requirement, not just as a data field convention? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a, Contract §BlockFreshness convention]
- [x] CHK008 Is “sem degradação perceptível” translated into measurable or reviewable requirements somewhere in the feature artifacts? [Gap, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK009 Is the no-mock policy (explicit prohibition of mock in any scenario) stated in the spec as a functional requirement, not just in research decisions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK010 Is the phrase “seam técnico privado do backend” backed by clear requirement boundaries about what must remain invisible to end users in this phase? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009b, Plan §Implementation Notes]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the access requirements stay consistent between the spec’s “qualquer usuário autenticado”, the contract’s `Authenticated` route, and the plan’s tenant narrative centered on an administrator? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001a, Contract §Route Contract, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 Are the overview blocks listed in the spec, contract, and data model fully aligned without extra or missing sections in any artifact? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 to §FR-007, Contract §Inertia Page Contract, Data Model §Microsoft365Overview]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can SC-001 be objectively verified from requirements alone, including what qualifies as “all essential overview blocks”? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Contract §Contract Rules]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are alternate requirements defined for tenants with partial Microsoft 365 adoption, where some workloads exist but others are unavailable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §Scale Assumptions]
- [x] CHK019 Is the scenario where a Graph call succeeds for some blocks but fails for others (mixed fresh/stale overview) explicitly addressed as a requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012b, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Does the spec define whether a future Graph-enabled block may coexist beside still-editorial blocks without implying an inconsistent product state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Contract §Contract Rules]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements explicit for zero-data or empty-data cases for each major overview block, not just the page as a whole? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract]
- [x] CHK022 Is the requirement that `lastUpdatedAt` MUST reflect the timestamp of the last SUCCESSFUL Graph call (not the time the snapshot was served) clearly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a, Contract §BlockFreshness convention, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam `cachePolicy`]
- [x] CHK023 Is the CSV exception for `serviceUsage30d` covered by requirements strongly enough to prevent accidental leakage of raw report format into the page contract? [Coverage, Research §Decision 6, Contract §Official Endpoint Mapping, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 Are security/privacy requirements specified for future environment-based Graph credentials and backend-only access boundaries, or are these left as planning assumptions? [Gap, Spec §FR-009b, Plan §Technical Context, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

## Requirement Completeness — Cache/Snapshot & BlockFreshness (Reescopo)

- [x] CHK031 Are requirements for `BlockFreshness` (`lastUpdatedAt` + `fresh`) specified for every structured block type (`summaryCards`, `secureScore`, `serviceStatus`, `licenseDistribution`, `serviceUsage30d`, `recommendations`) without exception? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012a, Contract §Inertia Page Contract, Data Model §SummaryIndicator to §Recommendation]
- [x] CHK032 Is the explicit exclusion of `BlockFreshness` from editorial blocks (`tenantHighlights`, `recentActivity`, `nextStep`) documented as a requirement, not just as a contract convention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012a, Contract §Contract Rules, Data Model §EditorialInsight, Data Model §RecentActivityItem]
- [x] CHK033 Is the requirement that all structured blocks MUST be fed by real Microsoft Graph data (not mock, not backend-prepared) stated consistently in spec, plan, contract, data model, and research? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Contract Rules, Research §Decision 8, Plan §Summary, Data Model §Overview]
- [x] CHK034 Are the `graph-backed` (fresh), `stale` (cache/snapshot), `editorial`, `empty`, and `informational` block states defined clearly enough to avoid inconsistent interpretation across overview blocks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam]
- [x] CHK035 Is the scenario where a Graph call fails and no cached snapshot exists (first execution or expired cache) explicitly covered as a requirement with `empty`/`informational` normalization? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012c, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK036 Is the requirement-level behavior for each transient Graph failure type (timeout, 429, 5xx, token expired) explicitly mapped to the cache/snapshot response with `fresh: false`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012b, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract]
- [x] CHK037 Are observability/diagnosability requirements defined for distinguishing `graph-backed`, `stale`, `partial`, `editorial`, `empty`, and `informational` block states in a support/review context? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam `diagnosticStates`]
- [x] CHK038 Is the cache storage mechanism (Laravel cache, driver from `config/cache.php`, TTL per block) specified as a requirement or explicitly deferred to implementation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Storage, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam `cachePolicy`]
- [x] CHK039 Are specific TTL values per block defined in requirements, or is the TTL intentionally left as an implementation decision with only the per-block granularity requirement stated? [Gap, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam `cachePolicy`, Plan §Implementation Notes]
- [x] CHK040 Is the requirement that the "Última att. em {tempo relativo}" indicator MUST be visible and comprehensible in the UI for every structured block with `fresh: false` measurable and testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026a, Contract §Contract Rules]
- [x] CHK041 Is the recovery behavior (Graph call succeeds again → block returns to `fresh: true` and snapshot is updated) explicitly stated as a requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012d, Data Model §MicrosoftGraphIntegrationSeam `State Transitions`]
- [x] CHK042 Is the requirement that credentials/tokens/consent details MUST NOT appear in Inertia props or visible UI elements consistent across spec, contract, data model, and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Error and Empty-State Contract, Plan §Implementation Notes]
- [x] CHK043 Are the Graph application permissions (`Reports.Read.All`, `ServiceHealth.Read.All`, `LicenseAssignment.Read.All`, `Directory.Read.All`, `SecurityEvents.Read.All`) documented as prerequisites rather than silently assumed as runtime guarantees? [Assumption, Spec §FR-024a, Research §Decision 4, Contract §Official Endpoint Mapping]
- [x] CHK044 Is the derivation logic for `recommendations` from real `secureScoreControlProfiles` (top 5 by severity/impact) specified clearly enough to distinguish from arbitrary editorial selection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Official Endpoint Mapping, Data Model §Recommendation]
- [x] CHK045 Is the no-mock policy (explicit prohibition of mock as fallback in any scenario) stated consistently and without contradiction across all feature artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-022, Contract §Contract Rules, Research §Decision 8, Research §Decision 10]

## Notes

- Use esta checklist para alinhar e expandir a cobertura dos requisitos antes de `/speckit-tasks` ou implementação.
- Itens marcados como `[Gap]` indicam áreas que provavelmente pedem complementação explícita na spec/plan/contract.
- Validation summary: 45/45 items currently pass.
- Artefatos ajustados para atingir 45/45:
  - `spec.md` FR-012a: adicionada exclusão explícita de `BlockFreshness` de blocos editoriais (CHK032)
  - `spec.md` FR-012d: nova FR para recovery automático (Graph volta → `fresh: true` + snapshot atualizado) (CHK041)
  - `spec.md` FR-022: adicionado `editorial` à lista de estados de bloco para consistência com FR-026 e data-model (CHK026)
  - `spec.md` FR-026a: indicador "Última att." tornado mensurável (posição dentro/adjacente ao bloco, contraste mínimo, legibilidade desktop/mobile) (CHK040)
  - `plan.md` Implementation Notes: TTL por bloco explicitamente declarado como decisão de implementação, não requisito de especificação (CHK039)
  - `data-model.md` cachePolicy: TTL valores específicos como decisão de implementação + recovery automático (CHK039, CHK041)
- 5 itens STALE (CHK007, CHK009, CHK019, CHK022, CHK026) foram reescritos para testar conceitos atuais (fresh/stale distinction, no-mock policy, mixed fresh/stale overview, lastUpdatedAt semantics, diagnostic state naming consistency).
- Revalidation result: todos os conceitos do reescopo (Graph real, cache/snapshot, BlockFreshness, no-mock, "Última att." indicator, recovery) estão agora explicitamente cobertos como requisitos em spec, plan, contract, data model e research.
